y1: After being baptized, the Holy Spirit led Jesus into the wilderness.
y2: Jesus fasted and prayed for 40 days without eating anything. Then He was very hungry.
y4: Then the devil came and tempted Jesus: “If You are the Son of God, tell these stones to become bread.”
y5: Jesus answered with words from the Bible: “Man shall not live by bread alone, but by every Word that comes from the mouth of God.”
y7: The devil took Jesus to the roof of the temple and said, “Throw Yourself down, the angels will catch You.” Jesus overcame by saying, “Do not test your God.”
y8: The devil showed Him all the kingdoms of the world from a high mountain and said, “If You worship me, I will give You all of these.” Jesus said, “Go away, Satan! Worship only God.”
y10: Finally, the devil left Jesus alone and went away. Jesus won!
y11: Then angels came and served Jesus. God's Word is the strongest power to overcome temptation.
verse: “Man shall not live by bread alone, but by every Word of God.”
prayer: Dear Lord God, I praise Jesus for overcoming temptations with the Word. When I am tempted to do wrong, help me to remember Your Word. Help me to bravely say 'no'. I pray in the name of Jesus Christ. Amen.
d0: wilderness. A dry place where almost no one lives. Jesus stayed in the wilderness for 40 days.
d1: fast. Not eating food for a while to focus on God. Jesus fasted for 40 days.
d2: devil. An evil spirit who opposes God and tempts people to do wrong. He is also called Satan. The devil tempted Jesus three times.
d3: temptation. Trying to get someone to do something wrong. Jesus overcame every temptation.
d4: Word. God's words written in the Bible. Jesus answered with the Word every time.
d5: temple. A large building in Jerusalem where people worshipped God. The devil took Jesus to the roof of the temple.
d6: worship. Bowing down with great respect to honor God. We worship only God.
d7: angel. A heavenly messenger sent by God. Angels served Jesus.
